verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe setting up outbound webhooks by event type (e.g. `WORKFLOW_COMPLETED`, whose payload carries the screening result). Each delivery includes a `webhook-id` header to use as an idempotency key, and webhook signing is available as a per-account opt-in, so the core subscribe-to-events capability is documented. missing for 10: documentation of how endpoints are registered (API vs UI), a full event-type catalog, retry/delivery semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
